slice: Fresh web search for NEW WhatsApp group directories — Africa + Middle East focus (groupssor API, groupjoin.link NG/ZA/DZ, wglfinder, groupsnest, wagroupshub, groupwa.com ZW/Jeddah, 77links Arabic, Dubai, Kenya)
sources: search snippets (Kaapjag PDF, ATEA, Likoni TVC, FlexiFunnels, YouTube)
notes: New directories mined for the first time this wave: groupssor.com (public JSON API, latest 500 only, ignores limit/offset), groupjoin.link country pages (NG 573 / ZA 149 / DZ 210 claimed), wglfinder.com (Arab focus), groupsgyani.org and groupwa.link gallery are JS-gated and banked as NEEDS-BROWSER-LEG leads.
wagroupshub.com (390 codes) and 77links.com Arabic (72 codes) and techsslash Kenya (10 codes) yielded ZERO fresh codes — already fully harvested; skip in future waves.
groupjoin.link pagination repeats page-1 codes (NG p2 = 0 fresh); detail pages /group/<slug> are the unmined remainder.

Slow-check finding: all 208 invites returned HTTP 200, but only 13 had a non-empty og:title on first pass and only 1 more recovered across 2 spaced retry rounds (195 + 192 checks). The 200+empty pages are the bare WhatsApp shell (og:description 'WhatsApp Group Invite', no name/title anywhere) — treated as dead per the ambiguous rule after 2 retries. Yield is honestly low: 10/208.

Post-verify screen caught 4 adult groups the listing screen missed because og:title differed from the listing name (leet spellings s3x / ẞEX, 'video call girl', peach/eggplant emoji). Lesson: always screen on og:title, and add leet/emoji patterns to the screen list.

Pre-verify screen dropped 122 codes (mostly porn/sex/hookup in groupssor dating category, plus SHEYI, crypto-airdrop and free-money pitches). Prohibition sentences were stripped before screening as instructed.
Borderline kept: 'GMAILS WORK' (DZ, Community & Social) — possibly Gmail-account trading; not in the mandatory drop list, flagged here for the merger to judge.
groupslinks.com resolves to adult-heavy groupslinks.pk — banked as a lead with DO-NOT-MINE note.
No transport failures: pending is empty. No files outside the wave dir were edited; groups.json untouched.
